title: Grahm Bundle v1
description: Normative schema for a .grahm continuity bundle: a fully pinned, offline-verifiable description of a deployable continuity unit. DRAFT, not frozen. Rule IDs cited in descriptions are defined in the rule registry in grahm-bundle-v1.md section 9, which also states which rules this schema CAN and CANNOT enforce. Schema validity is necessary but NOT sufficient for conformance; the linter enforces the remainder.

version.description: B-101: the runtime rejects a version lower than the highest previously installed version for this name (E_ROLLBACK).

created.description: RFC 3339 UTC. Informational only; freshness decisions use integrity.tuf expiry, not this field.

license.description: SPDX expression for the bundle definition itself. B-403 governs dataset licences, which are tracked separately and may impose share-alike obligations (e.g. ODbL for OSM-derived data).

items.description: B-202: 'probe' is required. A capability that cannot be functionally probed cannot be health-checked, and therefore cannot be qualified.

providedBy.description: B-201: MUST name a services.components[].id. Cross-reference; enforced by the linter, not by this schema.

range.description: B-203: comparator or exact form only. Wildcards ('*', 'x', 'latest') are rejected; bundles contain no floating references.

degradedWithout.description: B-203a: required when optional is true. States what the deployment loses if unsatisfied.

hardware.description: B-301: checked at plan time, before any byte is fetched. An unsatisfiable requirement produces a plan refusal (E_HARDWARE_UNSATISFIED), never a runtime failure. B-302: 'ram' and 'storage' are MINIMUMS the host must have free, not allocations; they MUST be >= the sum of services.components[].resources (linter-enforced).

networking.description: B-303: 'none' asserts full function with no interface up and is mutually exclusive with every other value (linter-enforced).

ups_health_required.description: B-304: when true, the runtime must observe UPS battery health, not merely its presence. A dead UPS reporting present would otherwise let a host claim ORB-2.

delivery.description: B-401: a 'referenced' dataset absent at install produces a plan refusal (E_DATASET_MISSING), never a silent partial install.

freshness.description: B-402: evaluated at QUERY time, not install time. Exceeding max_age_days degrades answers; it never deletes data.

generated_at.description: When this dataset was built. NOT the basis for age.

source_as_of.description: B-402a: age is computed from source_as_of, NEVER from generated_at. Rebuilding a dataset over a three-year-old source extract must not reset its age.

provenance.description: B-403: datasets requiring heavy computation (e.g. routing tiles) are built ahead of time; the runtime never builds them on the ORB. B-404: source_license is recorded because derived datasets can carry share-alike obligations (e.g. ODbL for OSM-derived data).

build_attestation.description: B-405: digest of a signed in-toto-style build attestation binding source_digest to this dataset digest. Guards against a poisoned upstream extract yielding a correctly-signed, fresh, wrong dataset.

facilityRef.description: B-406: binds a dataset to the Facility Truth revision it was built from. The runtime MUST compare this against the live fact-store revision at query time and report the skew; a dataset revision behind the fact store cannot be the sole basis for a safety-relevant answer.

image.description: B-501: MUST be digest-pinned. Tags are rejected (E_UNPINNED_REFERENCE).

backend.description: Apply backends supported. Absence means any container backend.

storageEncryption.description: B-504: components persisting incident, credential, or audit data MUST declare 'required'. The ORB is a physical box that can be stolen.

dependsOn.description: B-502: the graph MUST be acyclic (E_CYCLE). Linter-enforced; JSON Schema cannot express this.

degradedMode.description: B-503: what the deployment does when this component is unavailable. There is no 'silent' option anywhere in this schema.

userMessage.description: Folded into Answer Receipts. MUST state what is unavailable, not merely that something failed.

wan_required.description: B-601: a bundle declaring true cannot achieve a Continuity Grade above C.

max_offline_days.description: B-605: beyond this, every Answer Receipt MUST carry envelope_exceeded=true. The deployment keeps serving; it stops claiming it is inside its qualified envelope.

answerPolicy.description: strict: refuse when any source breaches freshness. degraded_with_receipt: answer, but the receipt MUST set freshness.breached and answer_kind MUST be degraded_answer. B-602: producing an answer without a receipt is non-conformant under both values.

refusalAllowed.description: B-603: refusal is a first-class answer kind and cannot be disabled.

max_grace_seconds.description: B-606: site-side ceiling on credential grace. The effective grace is min(credential.offline_grace_seconds, this). Without it, a credential decides how long it outlives itself.

quorum.description: B-607: minimum 2. A quorum of one is not a quorum.

requires_audit_entry.description: B-604: break-glass not hash-chained into the audit log is indistinguishable from a compromise.

may_write_facility_verification.description: B-608: break-glass MUST NOT create or modify facility verification records. Otherwise an insider can re-verify a sealed exit through the very path provided for emergencies, defeating acceptance test A4.7.

canonicalization.description: B-701: digests are computed over RFC 8785 JCS bytes. Note RFC 8785 section 3.2.2.1 explicitly does NOT perform Unicode normalisation; NFC and NFD inputs are different strings with different digests, by design.

signatures.description: B-702a: at least one bundle_author signature is REQUIRED. Without this, a bundle signed only by the qualification authority would be conformant, letting that key author bundles.

role.description: B-702: facility_authority keys are customer-held; bundle_author keys are vendor-held. One key in two roles is non-conformant (linter-enforced: keyId uniqueness across roles).

keyId.description: MUST resolve to a key in trustAnchor.keys.

mode.description: B-703: keyless/Fulcio signing is non-conformant. Its offline verification depends on a trusted root that goes stale with no offline refresh mechanism.

trustAnchor.description: B-704: the trust anchor ships IN-BAND as a blob in the bundle, not merely as a digest. Without carriage, 'verifiable with no network at any point' is unachievable. Expiry is surfaced as a loud operator warning, never a silent pass.

supersedesKeyId.description: B-706: key rotation chain. A rotated key MUST name its predecessor so an offline ORB can follow the chain from the root it already trusts.

referrerIndex.description: B-705: install MUST NOT depend on a live referrers query. Resolved without circularity: the deliverable is an OCI image INDEX whose members are the bundle manifest and its referrers; the bundle_author signature is over the INDEX, not over a document containing its own signature's digest.

tuf.description: Freshness and anti-rollback metadata. Required: without it E_STALE_METADATA cannot be evaluated and Q-09 is unrunnable.

revocation_epoch_floor.description: B-707: a FLOOR only. The live epoch is carried in the facility-authority-signed revocation feed, because revoking a staff credential is a customer act and must not require the vendor to sign a new bundle. MUST NOT decrease.

dataCompat.description: B-801: rollback across a declared-incompatible migration MUST be refused by name, not attempted.

then.$comment: B-904: an advisory bundle may not claim a grade above C. An unenforced grade is cosmetic.

requiredTests.description: B-903: the mandatory floor (Q-08 clock, Q-09..Q-12 all REJECT tests, Q-16 stale-data honesty, Q-17a/b credential expiry in both directions, Q-21 revision skew) MUST be present in every bundle regardless of hardware class. Without a floor, a bundle selects the tests it is graded on and earns grade A vacuously.

enforcement.description: B-901: under 'enforcing', qualification runs against the STAGED deployment before activation; a grade below minimumGrade blocks activation and triggers rollback (E_GRADE_BELOW_MINIMUM). Overriding requires a signed, audit-logged override.

hardwareClassMatrix.description: B-902: a grade is scoped to (bundle, hardware class, site). B-905: where a matrix entry matches the detected class it takes precedence over minimumGrade; minimumGrade applies only to classes absent from the matrix.

capabilityId.description: cap:<domain>.<function>[.<qualifier>]@<major>. B-205: qualifiers do NOT subsume. cap:routing.pedestrian.indoor@1 does not satisfy a requirement for cap:routing.pedestrian@1; a provider satisfying both MUST declare both.

byteSize.description: Binary units only, avoiding the 1000-vs-1024 ambiguity. e.g. '16GiB'.

orbClass.description: B-306: ORB-0 < ORB-1 < ORB-2 < ORB-3 for satisfaction ordering. ORB-X is NOT ordinal; a bundle requiring ORB-X is satisfied only by ORB-X.

capabilityProbe.description: B-202: probes are functional. 'port is open' and 'process is running' are not conformant probes.

expect.description: B-202a: at least one substantive assertion on the response BODY is required. A status-only expectation is a liveness check wearing a probe's name.

jsonPath.description: B-202b: RFC 9535 JSONPath. The dialect is normative; Goessner and jq variants disagree and would make probe outcomes implementation-defined.

interval_seconds.description: B-206: REQUIRED when run_when includes 'periodic', and capped. The interval bounds the window in which a silently-degraded service is reported healthy and every answer inside it carries a clean receipt.
